header: This is the GEOMETRY of a roster page (image analysis only, no OCR): the table frame, the merged DATE cells, the ruled line under every row, and a clean crop of each date cell's printed text. I let the geometry decide which rows belong to which date; Gemini only reads the words and the printed dates.

members.name: rowEdges
doc: The y of every ruled line between rows of the table (the frame's top and bottom included), top to bottom.

symbols.name: rosterPageGeometry
symbols.sig: export async function rosterPageGeometry(pngIn: Buffer): Promise<RosterGeometry | null>
doc: Returns the geometry of a roster page, or null when the page has no ruled table with a date column.

symbols.name: cropCellText
symbols.sig: export async function cropCellText(g: Gray, band: { xL: number; xR: number }, cell: DateCell, binarize = false): Promise<{ png: Buffer; cy: number } | null>
symbols.returns: Promise<{ png: Buffer; cy: number } | null>
doc: The printed text of a date cell, cut out on its own: I paint out long vertical strokes (a cell rule that wandered into the cell) first, then take a tight box around what is left, enlarged. `cy` is the vertical centre of the text. null = nothing printed in the cell.
